name: Ryota Takeuchi
bio: Ryota Takeuchi (竹内 良太, Takeuchi Ryōta, September 22, 1982) is a Japanese voice actor from Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture. Currently affiliated with Aoni Production, previously he was attatched to Mio Creation and Arts Vision. His vocal range is bass baritone and he speaks the Kansai dialect. He is married to fellow voice actress Ai Terashima (寺島 愛, Terashima Ai).
